name: Kuranda
note: Town: rainforest village on the Atherton Tablelands edge above Cairns, with the arts and craft markets, wildlife parks and rail and cable links; a base and draw in its own right.

name: Yungaburra
note: Town: Atherton Tablelands village beside Lake Tinaroo and the crater lakes, the base for platypus viewing, cafés and the monthly markets.

name: Cardwell
note: Town: small coastal town on the Hinchinbrook Channel, the gateway to Hinchinbrook Island and the Cardwell Range.

name: Mission Beach
note: Town and beach village on the Cassowary Coast, the base for Dunk and Bedarra island trips and the rainforest walks around it.

name: Palm Cove Jetty
note: Jetty: the Palm Cove waterfront jetty listed under See by the Wikivoyage Palm Cove page, a beach-side stop north of Cairns.

name: Barron Falls
note: Waterfall: 125 m tiered falls on the Barron River near Kuranda, with a lookout the Tropical North Queensland board calls the most famous waterfall lookout in Queensland.

name: Kuranda Original Rainforest Markets
note: Market: Kuranda's arts and crafts market, open Thursday to Monday, so a weekly-plus-trading market; judged against the permanent-venue rule.

name: Kuranda Heritage Markets
note: Market: second Kuranda arts and crafts market, open Thursday to Sunday, so a weekly market; judged against the permanent-venue rule.

name: Kur Cow Barnwell Farm
note: Farm experience: working farm at Myola, about six minutes from Kuranda, promoted by the Tropical North Queensland board.

name: Shaylee Strawberry Farm
note: Farm: strawberry farm on the Atherton Tablelands, named by the Tropical North Queensland board as a food stop.

name: Skybury Coffee
note: Coffee plantation: Atherton Tablelands coffee farm where visitors walk through the plantation, see the beans processed and taste the coffee.

name: Yungaburra Markets
note: Market: the largest and oldest market on the Tablelands, held on the fourth Saturday of the month, so a monthly event rather than a permanent venue.

name: Atherton Forest Mountain Bike Park
note: Mountain bike park: almost 60 km of purpose-built trails through the open forest from the town of Atherton.

name: Davies Creek Mountain Bike Park
note: Mountain bike park: network of trails in the Lamb Range near Mareeba, named by the Tropical North Queensland board; may overlap Davies Creek National Park.

name: Mount Baldy
note: Hike: steep 3 km return walk to views at the top, with an option to extend to Yabi Mountain, near Yungaburra.

name: Chillagoe-Mungana Caves National Park
note: National park: limestone cave systems and karst formations near Chillagoe, named by the Tropical North Queensland board as a Tablelands highlight.

name: Cairns Esplanade Lagoon
note: Swimming lagoon: 4800 sq m saltwater pool along the Cairns Esplanade, the city's stand-in for a beach.

name: Rusty's Markets
note: Market: Cairns fresh-produce market open Friday and Saturday, so a weekly market; judged against the permanent-venue rule.

name: Lake Morris
note: Lake: urban lake in Cairns with a walk around its shore, named by the Tropical North Queensland board beside the Botanic Gardens; marginal.

name: Low Isles
note: Reef cay: protected lagoon off Port Douglas, about 15 km from the coast, a beginner snorkel stop; may belong to the Port Douglas region rather than this one.

name: Lizard Island
note: Island national park: 1000 ha park with 24 beaches off the Cape York coast, the most northerly reef island in the Tropical North Queensland board's list; far north, may belong to the Cooktown region.

name: Mackay Cay
note: Reef cay: snorkelling cay off Cape Tribulation, named by the Tropical North Queensland board; may belong to the Daintree region.
